definition.zh: 判断资料来源的可靠性、相关性与合规性。
definition.en: Assessing the reliability, relevance and compliance of information sources.

definition.zh: 数据收集、清理、分析与可视化方法。
definition.en: Methods for data collection, cleaning, analysis and visualisation.

definition.zh: 数学、统计、数值分析、物理、化学、力学、工程制图与程序设计课程基础。
definition.en: Course foundations in mathematics, statistics, numerical analysis, physics, chemistry, mechanics, engineering drawing and programming.

definition.zh: 服装结构、材料、工艺、数字样版、生产、质量、市场与项目管理课程基础。
definition.en: Course foundations in garment structure, materials, construction, digital patterns, production, quality, market and project management.

definition.zh: 可持续设计、可持续面料以及服装产业环保与可持续知识。
definition.en: Knowledge of sustainable design, sustainable textiles, and environmental sustainability in the fashion industry.

name.zh: 哲学、批判理论与未来研究

definition.zh: 以哲学、未来研究和批判理论构建设计命题。
definition.en: Framing design propositions through philosophy, futures and critical theory.

definition.zh: 民族文化、宗教及其当代转译的研究方法。
definition.en: Research methods for ethnic cultures, religion and contemporary translation.

definition.zh: 人体、样版、廓形与成衣结构之间的关系。
definition.en: Relationships between body, pattern, silhouette and garment construction.

definition.zh: 针织、染色、纱线、面料改造与混合材料知识。
definition.en: Knowledge of knitting, dyeing, yarn, textile transformation and mixed materials.

definition.zh: 摄影语言、色彩空间、编码格式与调色逻辑。
definition.en: Visual language, colour spaces, codecs and grading logic.

definition.zh: 频率、动态、EQ、麦克风、路由与基础声学。
definition.en: Frequency, dynamics, EQ, microphones, routing and basic acoustics.

definition.zh: 程序化几何、材质、动画、渲染、扫描打印与物理场模拟。
definition.en: Procedural geometry, materials, animation, rendering, scanning, printing and physical-field simulation.

definition.zh: Web系统、API、版本控制、开源项目和部署知识。
definition.en: Knowledge of web systems, APIs, version control, open-source projects and deployment.

definition.zh: AI Agent、MCP、模型API、生成式媒体与知识库工作流。
definition.en: AI agents, MCP, model APIs, generative media and knowledge-base workflows.

definition.zh: 硬件、网络、Linux、虚拟化、存储、备份与家庭服务器。
definition.en: Hardware, networking, Linux, virtualisation, storage, backup and home servers.

definition.zh: 微控制器、串口、传感器、基础电路与焊接。
definition.en: Microcontrollers, serial communication, sensors, basic circuits and soldering.

definition.zh: HomeKit生态、设备联动、网络与自动化逻辑。
definition.en: HomeKit ecosystems, device integration, networking and automation logic.

definition.zh: 烹饪、咖啡、茶、酒与风味判断的实践知识。
definition.en: Practical knowledge of cooking, coffee, tea, alcohol and flavour assessment.

definition.zh: 检索和理解基础营养、生理及常用药物信息，不用于诊断或处方。
definition.en: Finding and understanding basic nutrition, physiology and common-medicine information, without diagnosis or prescribing.

definition.zh: 植物日常养护、虫害识别与基础处理。
definition.en: Everyday plant care, pest identification and basic treatment.

definition.zh: 文本判断、创意写作、歌词和文学评论。
definition.en: Textual judgement, creative writing, lyrics and literary criticism.

definition.zh: 基础经济、金融与个人投资信息的理解。
definition.en: Understanding of basic economics, finance and personal-investment information.

definition.zh: 围棋规则、局势判断与策略规划。
definition.en: Go rules, positional judgement and strategic planning.

definition.zh: 了解碟机、曲目结构和基础DJ工作流程，不声明表演能力。
definition.en: Understanding decks, track structure and basic DJ workflow, without claiming performance ability.
